name: Feedier
description: Feedier is the AI Analyst for your customer feedback. Ask it a question in plain English and get the number back with the verbatims behind it, no query language, no dashboard to build first. Pull NPS, CSAT, and CES across every survey and review channel as one unified set, broken down by product, region, or segment. Every KPI is computed server side against a fixed formula, not estimated by the model from raw text. Go further than a lookup: generate a focused action plan for any segment, and save the result as a report.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Feedier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Feedier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bx.feedier.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Feedier MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Feedier provides these MCP tools: discover, explore, generate-action-plan, measure, ping, report, and scope.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Feedier?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Feedier in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Feedier requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Feedier is developed by Feedier Technologies. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
